reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was '200 mg elemental, no magnesium oxide' plus the QR to a named ISO 17025 batch report, which is exactly what I check before buying. The Complex has only 60 mg of bisglycinate and I don't see why I'd want the other forms, so I'd take the plain bisglycinate for one box and see if it sits well.
objection: A QR on a TikTok Shop brand doesn't prove much until I open it and see a real report with this batch number and a lab I can look up. I'd also want to know what else is in the capsule besides magnesium, since the excipients aren't mentioned.
would_change_my_mind: Opening a sample QR report before buying and seeing a real lab, a real magnesium assay close to 200 mg, and a full ingredients list with no fillers I don't like.
